notes.title: V1.1 Update Now With Steam Achievements!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

Defensive Attacks got a new update!

What's New;

 Added reset button for all levels and upgrades to the level selection menu.

 Added speed button to levels for impatient players.

 A few optimizations and fixes have been made.

 Best of all, Steam achievements have been added to help you enjoy the game even more.

I hope you enjoy.

notes.title: Defensive Attacks Full Version Discount!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

After an exciting journey, I am happy to announce that Defensive Attacks has finally moved from Early Access to full release!

It has been a long time since the game was announced. Although I have released updates from time to time, I have not had enough time to bring the game to full release in the last 8 months. I hope you enjoy it.

What's New:

Expanded Gameplay: I have introduced new levels and challenges to keep you on your toes.

Improved Mechanics: Based on your valuable feedback, I have reworked various game mechanics for smoother and more strategic gameplay.

Stunning Visuals: Enjoy new backgrounds, defensive bases, and animations.

New Features: New defensive weapons, incoming enemy information menu, and additional upgrades.

A Heartfelt Thank You:
I would like to express my deepest gratitude to everyone who has contributed directly or indirectly to the game during this process.

Looking Ahead:
Defensive Attacks is now out of Early Access, but new updates and improvements will continue to come.

Thank you for being a part of this journey. See you in the game!

Best regards,

Bronzare Games

notes.title: Update (Version 0.3)
notes.notes:
Hello Players,

I just released a few new feature update. Hope this makes game a little more fun. Wait for new updates :) 

Added Features;

Bullet casing effect!
Multi-barreled rifle and machine gun will now warm up, 
a slightly more difficult game is waiting for you :)
Weapon management mode! this will get you more involved in the game.
You will now be able to remove your defenses without restarting the episode!


Notes;

You can't manage the mortars, for now :)
To remove or manage your defenses, you need to click on it and click the required button in the drop-down menu.
To close the menu, simply move the mouse away.
If you have upgraded, if you hold down the mouse button while managing bazookas, the missiles will hit the targeted enemy, but if you press and release the mouse button, they will not follow the target.

notes.title: Big Update Notes (Version 0.3)
notes.notes:
Hello gamers,

I know it's been a while since the last update. At the same time, I was busy with the game whenever I had time because I was working, I'm sorry about that. Here's what's new!


Upgrade System!

You will feel the explosions more with the screen shake effect!

More realistic shots!

Added new sound effects.


And more!

notes.title: Big Update Notes (Version 0.2)
notes.notes:
Hello gamers,

The game was released about six months ago. I've been working on an update ever since.
During this update procces, I developed the game from scratch. Thank you for waiting patiently.

Here is the update information;


It works stably in almost all systems.

The background image has been renewed.

Added blood effect.

Added bullet impact effect.

Added new sound effects.

The interface has been renewed.

The defense base has been renewed.

Infantry can now be deployed at any deployment point.

Bazooka can now be deployed in windows.

Added new music.

Added resolution setting.

Music and sound settings have been renewed.

Now you will know which enemies are coming.


And more!

notes.title: Update Notes
notes.notes:
- Fixed the issue of not working in offline mode.

- Fixed the issue of where the units placed in the window were placed at the same time.

- The shooting time of the rocket launcher enemy has been shortened.
